name: B-Luron
headline: B-Luron
description: A liquid oral course of chondroitin sulphate and hyaluronic acid for the joints. Taken over four weeks (2 x 500 ml), it supports the synovial fluid that cushions the joints and helps keep them mobile and comfortable.
howToUse: Adults – 30 ml (2 tablespoons or 1 measuring cup) a day after food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C. After opening, keep the bottle in the refrigerator.
manufacturing.ingredients: Chondroitin sulphate, hyaluronic acid, vitamin E, excipients.
